intro:
Stock shelves. Fuel cars.
Serve customers and earn profits.
Become the ultimate business owner!
description:
Build and manage your own supermarket and gas station. Stock shelves, refill fuel pumps, serve customers, and grow your business into a thriving roadside destination.

Upgrade your store, unlock new products, hire employees, and improve your services to increase profits. Can you create the ultimate supermarket and gas station empire?

Features:
Manage a supermarket and gas station
Restock products and refill fuel pumps
Upgrade and expand your business
Hire staff and improve efficiency
Unlock new products and equipment
Build your business empire
